objective: Locate and classify independently authored/recorded actual source-HTTP -> MCP tool response paired evidence for both success and error. Never replace causal evidence with two independently called equivalent APIs, MCP-over-HTTP transport or fabricated correlations.

admission_standard.tier1: Genuine independent developer-published, contemporaneously captured single causal upstream REST HTTP request/response followed by corresponding MCP tools/call response, with verifiable correlation beyond matching payloads; normal and error tested as distinct cases.
admission_standard.tier2: Independent developer's same-run two separate public HTTP and MCP interface calls to the same handler with matching arguments and outputs; semantic-parity evidence only, NOT causal upstream-to-MCP record.
admission_standard.tier3: Independently recorded one-sided MCP success/error or externally authored forwarding test source. No direct causal pair.
admission_standard.tier4: Written documentation of recorder potential with no committed observable output. Not counted.

preregistered_checks: All six source files fetched by immutable exact commit and git blob SHA
Monark MCP cascade step and independent HTTP mirror step have identical operation arguments and response objects
Monark two calls have distinct operations and separate steps; remain Tier2 not Tier1
Monark recorded error is a real MCP tools/call isError true with concrete code, without corresponding HTTP mirror error; Tier3 only
Cisco independent MCP requests and responses visible but no same-call upstream API HTTP
Tyk source test starts an HTTP upstream server and exercises its original handler with structured output, but no committed combined raw capture, and not full on-wire MCP
Meda independent proxy HTTP observations are MCP transport not upstream REST conversion
Do not infer raw HTTP response status for Monark mirrored interface where no status was recorded
FPR denominator requires independently adjudicated true negative causal pair; otherwise null
External confirmed success/error counted only Tier1 cases; Tier2 and 3 are never promoted
security: Offline evidence comparison; network used only for retrieving public SHA-pinned sources in CI; upload aggregate receipt and hashes, not raw traces or headers; never execute third-party source code.
